kill_clip.name: Kill Clip
kill_clip.description: Reloading after a kill grants +25% damage for a brief window.

frenzy.name: Frenzy
frenzy.description: After 12 seconds in continuous combat, +15% damage (also improves handling and reload).

surrounded.name: Surrounded
surrounded.description: +40% damage when 3 or more enemies are within 15m (swords +35%).

explosive_light.name: Explosive Light
explosive_light.description: Orb of Power pickups grant stacks, each shot spends one: grenade launchers +60% explosive damage, rocket launchers +25%.

bait_and_switch.name: Bait and Switch
bait_and_switch.description: Deal damage with all three equipped weapons within a short window to get +30% damage for 10s.

target_lock.name: Target Lock
target_lock.description: Damage ramps with continuous hits up to +40% at max stacks (PvP: 10.5% up to 25%).

rampage.name: Rampage
rampage.description: Kills grant a stacking damage bonus: +10% / +21% / +33.1% at ×1 / ×2 / ×3. Stacks expire one at a time.

golden_tricorn.name: Golden Tricorn
golden_tricorn.description: ×2 from a weapon kill of matching element (+15%). ×3 from an ability kill of matching element (+50%).

swashbuckler.name: Swashbuckler
swashbuckler.description: Kills grant stacks (up to ×5): +6.7% damage per stack, +33.3% at max.

adrenaline_junkie.name: Adrenaline Junkie
adrenaline_junkie.description: Kills grant stacks (grenade kills grant all five): +6.7% damage per stack, +33.3% at max, plus 20 Handling.

successful_warm_up.name: Successful Warm-Up
successful_warm_up.description: Weapon kills cut charge / draw time by 37.5% for 6s (it is not a damage buff).

vorpal_weapon.name: Vorpal Weapon
vorpal_weapon.description: More damage to minibosses, bosses, vehicles and Supered Guardians. PvE: primary +20%, special +15%, power +10%. PvP (vs Supers): +60% / +20% / +20%.

firing_line.name: Firing Line
firing_line.description: +20% precision damage when within 15m of two or more allies.

trench_barrel.name: Trench Barrel
trench_barrel.description: After a melee hit, the next 3 shots deal +50% damage with improved handling. Shotgun only.

desperado.name: Desperado
desperado.description: Finishing a reload shortly after a precision kill cuts firing delay by 30% for 7s (it is a rate-of-fire buff, not a damage buff).

high_ground.name: High Ground
high_ground.description: Kills grant stacks (PvP grants two per kill): +10% / +17.5% / +25% damage in PvE, +5% / +10% / +15% in PvP.

killing_tally.name: Killing Tally
killing_tally.description: Kills grant stacking damage: PvE 10 / 20 / 30%, PvP 5 / 10 / 15% at ×1 / ×2 / ×3. Stow or reload removes all stacks.

business_time.name: Business Time
business_time.description: Sweet Business: holding the trigger raises rate of fire by up to 60%.

desperation.name: Desperation
desperation.description: Necrochasm after a Cursed Thrall kill or a precision-kill reload: +20% rate of fire for 7s.

rat_pack.name: Rat Pack
rat_pack.description: Rat King: a stack for each ally within 20m holding Rat King (up to ×5): rate of fire +0 / 13 / 20 / 30 / 40%.

silkbound_slayer.name: Silkbound Slayer
silkbound_slayer.description: Wish-Keeper vs Suspended targets: PvE +125% body / +50% precision damage; PvP +44% body / +20% precision. 30% faster draw.

ignition_trigger.name: Ignition Trigger
ignition_trigger.description: Tommy's Matchbook after 20 rounds in quick succession: +100% damage in PvE, +50% in PvP.

release_the_wolves.name: Release the Wolves
release_the_wolves.description: Lord of Wolves hip-fire (automatic): +60% rate of fire, +39% body damage and +20% precision damage (bosses +10% body).

one_for_all.name: One For All
one_for_all.description: Hitting 3 different targets in quick succession grants +35% damage for 10.5s.

radiant.name: Radiant
radiant.description: Radiant (Solar, Song of Flame, Facet of Dawn, artifact orbs…): +25% weapon damage in PvE, +10% in PvP.

empowering_rift.name: Empowering Rift
empowering_rift.description: Warlock Empowering Rift: +20% weapon damage in PvE, +15% in PvP.

weapons_of_light.name: Weapons of Light
weapons_of_light.description: Titan Ward of Dawn. +25% weapon damage for all Guardians inside the bubble.

well_of_radiance.name: Well of Radiance
well_of_radiance.description: Warlock Well of Radiance: +25% weapon damage in PvE and PvP.

banner_shield.name: Banner Shield
banner_shield.description: Void Titan Sentinel Shield: allies shooting through it deal +40% weapon damage in PvE, +35% in PvP.

lumina_noble_rounds.name: Noble Rounds (Lumina)
lumina_noble_rounds.description: Lumina's Noble Rounds grant Blessing of the Sky: +35% weapon damage in PvE, +15% in PvP, for 11s.

weaken.name: Weaken
weaken.description: Void debuff: weakened targets take +15% damage in PvE, +7.5% in PvP.

tether.name: Shadowshot Tether
tether.description: Void Hunter Shadowshot: tethered targets take +30% damage in PvE, +50% in PvP.

divinity.name: Divinity
divinity.description: Divinity: targets in the cage take +15% damage in PvE, +7.5% in PvP.

blessing_of_the_sky.name: Blessing of the Sky
blessing_of_the_sky.description: Noble Rounds (Lumina) or Boots of the Assembler: +35% weapon damage in PvE, +15% in PvP.

disruption_break.name: Disruption Break
disruption_break.description: Breaking a shield with this weapon makes the target take +50% Kinetic damage for 5.5s. Stacks with every other buff and debuff, Kinetic weapons only.

tractor_cannon_debuff.name: Tractor Cannon
tractor_cannon_debuff.description: Tractor Cannon: hit targets take +30% damage in PvE, +50% in PvP, for 10s.

worm_byproduct.name: Worm Byproduct
worm_byproduct.description: Wormgod Caress (exotic gauntlets), at max stacks (×5): +35% weapon damage in PvE, +25% in PvP.

spark_of_frequency.name: Spark of Frequency
spark_of_frequency.description: Arc fragment. 0.80× Reload Duration Multiplier — Arc weapon hits with Bolt Charge stack reload speed to near-instant.

amplified.name: Amplified
amplified.description: Arc keyword. +40 Handling, 0.95× Ready/Stow Duration Multiplier, improved airborne effectiveness and sprint speed.

ember_of_tempering.name: Ember of Tempering
ember_of_tempering.description: Solar fragment. Solar weapon final blows grant Radiant to you and nearby allies. (Activate Radiant above for the damage bonus.)

sever.name: Sever
sever.description: Strand debuff: severed enemies deal reduced damage. It does not increase the damage they take.

whisper_of_hedrons.name: Whisper of Hedrons
whisper_of_hedrons.description: Stasis fragment: freezing a target increases weapon handling and grants health (the Weapon Surge is set under Armor Mods).

thread_of_ascent.name: Thread of Ascent
thread_of_ascent.description: Strand fragment. Activating grenade reloads your equipped weapon and grants +30 Airborne Effectiveness and +30 Reload Speed.

flow_state.name: Flow State
flow_state.description: Arc Hunter keyword. +40 Reload Speed and +20 Handling while active.

on_your_mark.name: On Your Mark
on_your_mark.description: Arc Hunter aspect: class ability or precision hits grant you and nearby allies reload speed and Weapons stat (up to ten stacks).

moebius_quiver.name: Moebius Quiver
moebius_quiver.description: Moebius Quiver tether: tethered targets take +30% damage in PvE, +50% in PvP.

deadfall.name: Deadfall
deadfall.description: Deadfall tether: enemies in its zone take +30% damage in PvE, +50% in PvP.

heat_rises.name: Heat Rises
heat_rises.description: Solar Warlock aspect: lets you fire while gliding; the grenade grants Heat Rises and a healing burst. Not a damage buff.

rally_barricade.name: Rally Barricade
rally_barricade.description: Titan class ability. Crouching behind the barricade instantly reloads your weapon and grants +50 Reload Speed.

sentinel_shield.name: Sentinel Shield
sentinel_shield.description: Void Titan Sentinel Shield: allies behind it deal +40% weapon damage in PvE, +35% in PvP (same effect as Banner Shield).

helm_of_saint_14.name: Helm of Saint-14
helm_of_saint_14.description: Helm of Saint-14 (exotic helmet): +25% weapon damage for 15s in PvE and PvP.

gyrfalcons_hauberk.name: Gyrfalcon's Hauberk
gyrfalcons_hauberk.description: Gyrfalcon's Hauberk (exotic chest): +35% weapon damage for 6s in PvE; not usable in PvP.

no_backup_plans.name: No Backup Plans
no_backup_plans.description: No Backup Plans (exotic leg armor), shotguns only: +35% damage in PvE, +10% in PvP.

hazardous_propulsion.name: Hazardous Propulsion
hazardous_propulsion.description: Hazardous Propulsion: +35% weapon damage for 10s in PvE (no published PvP value, so none is applied).

prismatic_transfer.name: Prismatic Transfer
prismatic_transfer.description: Prismatic Transfer (artifact): +20% weapon damage in PvE, +15% in PvP.

felwinters_helm.name: Felwinter's Helm
felwinters_helm.description: Felwinter's Helm (exotic helmet): enemies hit by its Void blast take +30% damage for 5-20s.

flash_counter.name: Flash Counter
flash_counter.description: Flash Counter: enemies take +20% damage for 4s.
